description: Fetch the counts on a company's People tab: where its people live, what they do, where they studied, what they are skilled at, each as a list of names and member counts. Use this to size a team, or to see where a company hires. Give exactly one of `url` or `vanity_name` or `company_id`. Costs 7 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

company_id.description: LinkedIn's numeric id for the company: `company_id` in linkedin/company. The fastest of the three.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

vanity_name.description: The part after `/company/` in the URL.

name: get_linkedin_employee_stats
title: Count a company's people on LinkedIn
